name: Kanojo-tachi wa Kyouhaku ni Kussuru
original_name: 彼女達は脅迫に屈する
source:
Based on Boku wa Tomodachi ga Sukunai.

Three ugly otaku were sick of feeling second-rate. They loitered after school, grumbling about all the tail that good-looking guys got.
While ducking back into the class for some forgotten item, they overheard a sultry voice, and saw the girl with raven black hair masturbating alone. This was perfect. They chose her to expunge their pent-up sexual frustation.

translation:
基于《我的朋友很少》。三个丑陋的宅男受够了二等公民的感觉。放学后他们四处闲逛，抱怨帅哥身边总有女人。回教室取忘带的东西时，他们偷听到一声娇喘，看到黑发少女独自自慰。完美。他们选中了她来发泄积压的性挫败。
